item.title: Kildare retain Division 1B status with comfortable win over Carlow
item.description: Kildare secured their Allianz Hurling League Division 1B status this afternoon by seeing off Carlow on a 3-22 to 1-19 scoreline at Cedral St Conleth's Park.

item.title: Clare hold off Wexford's late charge for sixth straight league win
item.description: Clare held off a late push from Wexford in Ennis this afternoon to win their sixth consecutive game in Division 1B of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Sunday's Allianz Hurling League results and tables
item.description: Below are this afternoon's Allianz Hurling League sixth round results...

item.title: Kilkenny display in Salthill "totally unacceptable" - Lyng
item.description: Kilkenny boss Derek Lyng lamented his side's "flat" display against Galway on Saturday evening in Salthill.

item.title: Kiely issues positive update on Limerick's injury issues
item.description: Limerick manager John Kiely has given a positive update on his side's injury issues following their win against Cork over the weekend.

item.title: "We'll learn a lot from it" - O'Connor
item.description: Cork boss Ben O'Connor says his side will learn a lot from the first defeat of their Allianz Hurling League campaign at the hands of Limerick on Saturday night.

item.title: Clare boss Lohan delighted with immediate return to Division 1A
item.description: Clare manager Brian Lohan said a quick return to Division 1A of the Allianz Hurling League was crucial for his side after the disappointment of relegation last year.

item.title: "I saw fellas giving up near the end of that game"
item.description: Former Clare and Dublin manager Anthony Daly says he was surprised to see some of the Kilkenny players "giving up" towards the end of Saturday's loss to Galway in Salthill.

item.title: Cavan's Niamh Keenaghan is the LGFA February Player of the Month
item.description: Cavan star Niamh Keenaghan has been honoured with The Croke Park Hotel/LGFA Player of the Month award for February 2026.

item.title: Waterford v Tipperary re-fixed for this Sunday
item.description: The postponed Allianz Hurling League clash between Waterford and Tipperary has been re-fixed for this Sunday at Azzurri Walsh Park (throw-in 2pm).
